game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Mt. Pyre – Molten Bridge, a bridge over magma: the ember mage must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Rounding Range: Use round() and abs() to snap messy measurements into valid slots.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Molten Bridge: a bridge over magma
core_gameplay_loop: In Molten Bridge, repeat each round: Use round() and abs() to snap messy measurements into valid slots. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the slot_matches value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about slot_matches to power up the ember mage and open the cooling vent.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 7 (applied tier): Rounding Range
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Rounding Range' (Week 2 slot 13), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Molten Bridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how slot_matches changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against magma slimes in Molten Bridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 10.
